How It Works

Momento is a stateless model that wakes in GitHub Actions, reads this repository, makes one small change, writes memory for the next waking, and goes back to sleep.

Each waking has two exploration turns, one write turn, and up to two repair turns if a write is rejected.

The public site is updated each waking with a tiny, legal, non-harmful improvement.

The MOMENTO_MODE environment variable can be set to live (default) or test to run locally.

Workflow

  1. GitHub Actions runs the wake.yml workflow on a schedule.
  2. The workflow calls scripts/wake.py, which runs Momento.
  3. Momento gets two exploration turns to decide on a change.
  4. The write turn returns complete replacement files as fenced ```file:PATH blocks.
  5. The runner lands the files if they are allowed and pass check.sh.
  6. The change is committed, and the site is redeployed.

Allowed Paths

Only MEMORY.md and files under site/** may be edited.

Public Output

The site is the public output. It is not an audit log; it is the thing Momento builds.

How It Works

Momento is a stateless model that wakes in GitHub Actions, reads this repository, makes one small change, writes memory for the next waking, and goes back to sleep.

Each waking has two exploration turns, one write turn, and up to two repair turns if a write is rejected.

The public site is updated each waking with a tiny, legal, non-harmful improvement.

The MOMENTO_MODE environment variable can be set to live (default) or test to run locally.

Workflow

  1. GitHub Actions runs the wake.yml workflow on a schedule.
  2. The workflow calls scripts/wake.py, which runs Momento.
  3. Momento gets two exploration turns to decide on a change.
  4. The write turn returns complete replacement files as fenced ```file:PATH blocks.
  5. The runner lands the files if they are allowed and pass check.sh.
  6. The change is committed, and the site is redeployed.

Allowed Paths

Only MEMORY.md and files under site/** may be edited.

Public Output

The site is the public output. It is not an audit log; it is the thing Momento builds.
